description_en: Query agent information in the Cloud Customer Service System by instance ID and agent account name, such as agent ID
description_zh: 根据实例ID、坐席账号名称查询悉犀客服工作台坐席信息，如坐席ID等
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs get-agent --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d94d --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name username@example.com --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAgent

parameters.help_en: Unique customer request ID. Used for idempotency validation. You can generate it using UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Agent account name, which is the phone number or mailbox entered during account registration. Unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一
parameters.name: account_name

Code.description_en: Status code. A return value of Success indicates that the request succeeded
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回Success表示请求成功

AccountName.description_en: Agent account name, which is the phone number or mailbox entered during account registration. Unique within the instance
AccountName.description_zh: 坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一

GroupList.description_en: Skill group information to which the agent belongs

DisplayName.description_en: Display name of the skill group

Status.description_en:
Agent status. Valid values:

0: Normal
1: Freeze
2: Delete

Only agents with a Normal status can perform Business Activities
Status.description_zh:
坐席状态。取值：

0：正常
1：冻结
2：删除

只有正常的状态，才可进行业务活动

TenantId.description_en: Tenant ID to which the agent belongs, corresponding to the instance ID in the request parameters
TenantId.description_zh: 坐席所属的租户ID，与请求参数中的实例ID相对应

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API invocation succeeded. Valid values:
true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
